generation.cache_reuse: compatible B1 candidate0; missing/incompatible slots regenerated once with reason
generation.pipeline: B1 legacy increment guard; repair_enabled=false; Temporal disabled

score.coverage: each window predicts local2..15; preceding history is excluded, so every global future frame counted once
score.mismatch: roll temporal occ_list[1:] by +16 cells in X (tensor dimension2), periodic within native32 grid; anchor/goal/occ_pos/object occupancy label convention unchanged
score.noise: private per(task,window,repeat,level), common across candidates/branches; restore clean history; KnownEmptyObjectView for216:232
score.failure: raise and preserve partial records; withhold quality decision, no invalid zero or complete-case pruning

selection.energy: mean human24 voxel nearest-free squared distance/(3*.05^2) + mean fixed128 object-surface distance/(3*.05^2); equal future-frame weighting
selection.endpoint: final coarse root/object XZ distance to external goal; <=max(C0,.10m), with strict<.10 when C0<.10
selection.contact: all future frames: min distance of either FK hand22/23 to fixed128 object surface; mean<=C0+.01m and fraction<.10m>=C0-.05
selection.foot: proposal/source-floor support, both pair ends, mean XZ speed <= C0+.01m/s
selection.validity: finite complete motions, exact locked history/common/contact, all original editor final guards, world history discrepancy<=1e-5m
selection.fallback: all CG/CS/CF/CM select C0 if A empty; retain task; technical failure blocks decision

gate.coverage: 112 candidate slots /28 tasks; all valid scores; HSI choice testable if at least one B has>1 member; report restriction rates; incomplete technical execution BLOCKED
gate.visual_review: fixed014/329/371/420 plus worst CF-CG HS and new completion loss; human blind review pending if unavailable

diagnostics.oracle: after selection: among A, native completed>=CG, contact>=CG-.02, FS<=CG+.01, OS<=CG+.02 and endpoints<=CG+1cm; min native HS then candidate index; fallback CG; one actual candidate per task
